difference_plan.rationale: Objective (O) requires outputting a specific obstruction cell on failure. Core constraints (C) add that the obstruction must be a cell whose entire row and column are unusable. Invariant (V) introduces the local checkability of this witness.
difference_plan.summary: Replaced scalar '-1' with a cell index that proves impossibility. Added obligation to output either a covering set or that witness, and updated invariants to enforce the witness's correctness and verifiability.

objective.description: Output either a minimum-cardinality set of check start positions that covers all stations, or an obstruction cell whose row and column are entirely blocked.

rule_selection_reason: 该规则通过引入行列唯一性约束，将原题各行（或各列）独立选择 '.' 的轻耦合结构升级为全局匹配问题，实质改变了主求解状态和算法核心，创新幅度和难度提升显著高于其他规则。逆设计规则仍可能保留过多原题结构，构造/障碍规则则难以避免退化为输出格式浅改。；创新度判断：会将原题“每行选一个 '.' 即可”的独立分量义务拉向“必须同时满足行列互异”的全局耦合，从而迫使解法维护行与列之间的双向依赖，输出也从宽松的构造变成需要证明完美匹配的存在性。；难度判断：主求解责任从简单的行扫描构造变为二分图完美匹配判定，算法复杂度从 O(n^2) 跃升至 O(n^3)，并需要处理无解的新条件（无完美匹配）和路径构造，显著抬高算法设计和正确性证明门槛。；风险判断：主要风险是全局约束可能被误加为“每行每列恰一个 '.'”导致无解范围陡增，需仔细校准无解条件与原规律的继承关系；但该风险可通过让新约束直接在原可行性不变量上扩展来可控。

constraints.name: start_restriction
constraints.description: A check can only be started at a usable station ('.'). Starting at a station covers that station and all stations in the same row and the same column.
constraints.formal: A check start cell must be '.' .

constraints.name: full_coverage
constraints.description: Every station must be covered by at least one check start.
constraints.formal: For every cell (i,j), there exists a chosen start cell in row i or column j.

constraints.name: minimum_checks
constraints.description: If a full coverage is possible, the number of check starts must be minimized (exactly n).
constraints.formal: If a solution exists, output exactly n check start positions.

constraints.name: obstruction_output
constraints.description: If no full coverage is possible, output an obstruction certificate: a cell (r,c) such that row r and column c consist entirely of blocked stations ('E').
constraints.formal: In case of impossibility, output one cell (r,c) where a[r][i]='E' for all i and a[i][c]='E' for all i.

objective.description: Output either a minimum-cardinality set of check start positions that covers all stations, or an obstruction cell whose row and column are entirely blocked.

invariants.name: impossibility_condition
invariants.description: A full coverage exists iff there is no row full of 'E' or no column full of 'E'. If a solution exists, the minimum number of starts is n.

invariants.name: obstruction_verifiability
invariants.description: An output cell (r,c) is a valid obstruction only if row r is all 'E' and column c is all 'E'.

properties.check_locally: iterate through row r and column c

invariants.name: solution_structure
invariants.description: When a solution exists, an optimal set chooses exactly one start per column (if some row is all 'E') or exactly one per row (otherwise), always picking a '.' cell.

theme.name: 城市通勤

种子题的正向求解过于简单（检查一行全 E 且一列全 E 则无解，否则有 n 次施法解），将其反向设计为给定目标施法位置求最小网格修改后，问题退化为直接统计目标位置和非目标位置中标记与目标不一致的个数，算法核心没有本质变化，没有产生新的证明义务或求解难度。

algorithmic_delta_claim.seed_solver_core: Scan all rows and columns to find a full-'E' row and a full-'E' column. If both exist, output -1. Else, if a full-'E' row exists, for each column pick a '.' in that column; otherwise for each row pick a '.' in that row. Output selected cells.
algorithmic_delta_claim.reusable_subroutines: Scanning for full-'E' rows/columns, column/row '.' picking.
algorithmic_delta_claim.new_solver_core: Scan to find a full-'E' row (if any) and a full-'E' column (if any). If both exist, output the cell (r,c) at their intersection as obstruction; else construct a solution as before. The only difference is outputting (r,c) instead of -1.
algorithmic_delta_claim.new_proof_obligation: Prove that the output cell (r,c) indeed lies in a row and column that are both entirely blocked, and therefore cannot be covered by any valid start. This was implicit in the seed's impossibility check but must now be explicitly validated against the input.
algorithmic_delta_claim.why_direct_reuse_fails: The seed's -1 is not a structured certificate; a solver must extract the specific witness and format it. The new rule demands that the failure output be a directly checkable object, requiring the algorithm to pin down a concrete conflicting cell rather than just signal impossibility.

anti_shallow_rationale: Merely replacing -1 with a cell index while keeping the same solving logic would be a retheme if the certificate did not add a new verification obligation. However, the new objective demands that the output be self-verifiable without scanning the whole grid: checking the cell's row and column suffices. This shifts the failure semantics from a global flag to a local proof, which changes what the algorithm must explicitly compute and guarantee.

applied_helpers.selection_reason: The impossibility is naturally captured by a contradictory cell; turning it into an explicit certificate makes failure verifiable locally.
schema_changes: Added constraint: obstruction output must be a cell (r,c) with row r all 'E' and column c all 'E'.
Objective now includes an explicit obstruction branch.
applied_helpers.innovation_reason: Transforms impossibility from a boolean result into a structural witness, elevating the failure branch to a first-class output.
applied_helpers.difficulty_reason: Requires solutions to construct a concrete evidence object rather than just printing '-1', testing correct identification of the conflicting coordinates.

applied_helpers.selection_reason: Both the solution case and the impossibility case must now produce outputs of comparable representational weight.
schema_changes: Objective split into two symmetric branches: output a covering set or output a cell.
Core constraint makes both branches mandatory, forbidding degenerate failure handling.
applied_helpers.innovation_reason: Elevates failure from an afterthought to a structurally defined output, mirroring the success branch's precision.
applied_helpers.difficulty_reason: Forces the solver to uniformly handle both branches and craft a well-formed output in each, preventing trivial fallbacks.

applied_helpers.selection_reason: The obstruction cell is directly defined by the core constraints: a cell whose row and column are entirely blocked.
schema_changes: Invariant now states that the obstruction cell's row and column consist only of 'E'.
Core constraints link the impossibility condition to the existence of such a cell.
applied_helpers.innovation_reason: Anchors the evidence inside the main constraints, so the failure witness is not an external artifact but a natural consequence of the input structure.
applied_helpers.difficulty_reason: Demands that the algorithm reason about the interaction of row and column blockages to produce a valid witness.

details.review_role: 你扮演一名规范解审查官，重点判断种子题是否仍有空间升级为带规范性的构造输出。

Each line should consist of two integers denoting the row and column numbers...'，且 core_constraints 中 minimum_operations 也指定输出具体施法位置，objective 为 'providing the spell positions if possible'。这表明确实是原题强制输出完整方案。
details.feedback: 该种子题已经输出具体构造方案，虽然现有解不唯一，但加上规范顺序（如字典序最小）几乎不改变主要算法结构，不符合规则期望的从答案升级到带证明责任的规范解。建议挑选输出仅为数值或判断的种子题。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名冲突证书审查官，重点判断无解情形能否落成可局部检查的阻碍证据。

validation_trace.message: 原题中净化为静态、确定性过程，无顺序不确定性、资源波动或局部选择差异，无法提取原生扰动模型。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名保底优化审查官，重点判断原题语义中是否存在可被放大的原生扰动来源。
details.evidence: 根据 seed_schema.core_constraints，施法只受目标格子类型限制，净化效果覆盖整行整列，且目标最小化施法次数，无顺序或波动因素。invariant 指出存在性判断基于行和列的完全不可施法状态，最优解是固定选择每行或每列的某个可施法格子，与扰动无关。
details.feedback: 规则要求原题有顺序不确定、资源波动或局部选择差异，但此题完全确定，扰动只能从外部强加，违反红线‘不能凭背景硬造对手’。

validation_trace.message: 原题可行性由是否存在全 E 行和全 E 列同时存在决定，无单调参数可调优，无法自然升级为临界阈值优化。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名阈值优化审查官，重点判断可行性是否能自然升级为临界参数或极值阈值。
details.evidence: 原题核心约束中，可行性条件仅依赖于全 E 行与全 E 列的同时出现，没有连续参数（如 E 的数量、比例）可引入；规则 required_seed_properties 要求“可行性随某个参数具有清晰的单调性或分层结构”，原题完全满足二值判定，不满足此要求；规则 redlines 明确禁止“阈值只是在原判定外层做机械二分”，强行添加参数后仍会退化为二分判定，本质无变化。
details.feedback: 种子题缺少自然临界参数，强行扩展只会在外层包装二分搜索而无法改变主约束或证明结构，建议保持原优化形式或寻求其他变换规则。

validation_trace.message: 原题目标为单一的最小化施法次数，且所有约束均围绕此目标展开。题目中不存在自然的、与原目标真实冲突的第二评价指标；任何附加指标（如总净化次数）要么与施法次数单调正相关，退化为同一方向，要么完全可由原答案直接后处理得到，无法形成有意义的帕累托前沿。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名多目标权衡审查官，重点判断种子题是否存在自然且冲突的第二评价指标。
details.evidence: 在种子题 schema 中，objective 仅定义了 'minimize the number of spell casts'（核心约束中亦强调 'minimum_operations'），invariant 仅涉及可解性条件和最优次数等于维度 n，均未暗示存在另一个独立的、且与之冲突的指标。原题描述中的 'E' 与 '.' 仅影响施法位置限制，并未引入资源消耗、风险值或任何可量化的第二维度。规则的 'eligibility.required_seed_properties' 明确要求 '原题目标附近存在自然的第二评价指标' 且 '两个指标之间存在真实冲突'，该种子题不具备此性质。
details.feedback: 该种子题为典型的集合覆盖变种，目标空间一维，不适合直接应用 'single_objective_to_tradeoff_frontier' 规则。若需引入第二指标，将不得不人为添加与核心规律无关的额外约束，违反全局红线。

validation_trace.message: 原题输出（一组坐标）可被绑定为反向目标，要求通过修改输入中的字符（E↔.）来使得给定目标答案成为最优解，这个修改操作与原题核心对象直接相关，且存在最小修改的设计自由度。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名反向设计审查官，重点判断原题结果是否能作为目标，并存在自然修改或设计自由度。
details.evidence: 原题输出是具体的施法位置列表（examples中输出1 1等），原题核心约束禁止对'E'施法，因此修改字符直接影响施法可行性；标准解法中包含全'E'行/列的判断，修改操作即翻转字符，是原输入的自然结构。
details.feedback: 反向设计空间清晰，但需注意设计后的新题可能较简单（仅需统计目标位置中'E'的数量），可考虑增加额外复杂度（如允许修改任意位置，并要求最小化总修改次数使得存在某个解），以保持挑战性。

validation_trace.message: 原题各行独立选点，共享列空间，通过引入列互斥全局约束可将各行绑定为全局排列问题，形成跨组件依赖与全局守恒，难度显著提升且不违背任何红线。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名全局耦合审查官，重点判断局部独立单元是否能被共享资源或全局守恒自然绑定。
details.evidence: 原题 schema 中 core_constraints 说明各行只需存在 '.' 即可独立选点（见 spell_target_restriction 和 minimum_operations），invariant 指出最优次数为 n 且构造独立（optimal_spell_count_equals_dimension）；辅助规则 shared_resource_constraint 与 cross_component_dependency 允许将列视为共享资源并建立互斥依赖，符合规则全部 hard_checks。
details.feedback: 该规则适用于当前种子，局部单元（行）与共享资源（列）具备天然耦合性，可产生有效变体。

validation_trace.message: 原题操作本质是单人的确定性构造优化，不存在可自然对抗化的轮流选择语义；强行引入第二个玩家只能依靠故事背景，违反‘对抗方只能靠故事背景硬造’的红线。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名博弈化审查官，重点判断原题操作是否能自然转化为双方轮流选择。
details.evidence: 原题描述中只有一位冒险者，操作‘Purification’是单人施法；eligibility.forbidden_seed_properties 明确指出‘对抗方只能靠故事背景硬造’，而任何对抗化都只能通过叙事虚构另一方，无法从操作空间中自然衍生。原题的操作虽然可选不同单元格，但状态转移不产生分岔的对抗结果，不符合‘不同操作会改变后续可选状态’的博弈前提。
details.feedback: 该规则对种子题难以实现自然博弈化，建议寻找本身具有玩家轮流选择或对抗操作的原题。

validation_trace.message: 原题核心是全局覆盖问题，并非单路径、单区间或单子树性质，无法通过本规则从局部问题跃迁为覆盖/割/支配问题。

details.feedback: 种子题不具有本规则所需的局部结构起点，强行应用只会重复原题覆盖逻辑，无法产生实质性新问题。

validation_trace.message: 种子题是优化问题（最小化施法次数），不是计数问题，不存在计数对象，无法应用带权计数扩展。

details.review_role: 你扮演一名带权计数审查官，重点判断已有计数对象上是否存在自然权重、等级或统计量。
details.evidence: 种子题的objective.type为'minimize_value'，目标是最小化spells数量；core_constraints是关于施法限制和覆盖要求的，不是在计数对象上定义计数。原题摘要中无任何计数目标。
details.feedback: 规则要求原题有明确有限的计数对象，但该题不满足此前提，建议更换种子题。
